.qc-cache/hireops-2026-10-01-handoff-audit/task/solution/app/src/index.js: startup, timestamps, session generation and revision-ID generation
evidence:
Frozen workbook row 20 requires a committed static baseline on pinned values; the internal annotation agrees. Independently hashed all 35 frozen task files and 34 frozen rule files against manifest.json: zero mismatches. All 12 solution files also match their committed HEAD bytes exactly (git show comparison); targeted git status is clean. solve.sh copies the shipped app and resets only the disposable installation database, without fetching or regenerating the reference. The two seed_data.json copies are byte-identical (SHA256 1b39015461a7a4f23b835aeea9584caffd0266c64d394778376cbd6c8a18bcf7). db.js:14-15,122-179 seeds explicit roster rows and deterministic derived IDs/timestamps; nonempty users prevents reseeding. seed_data.json:3 pins 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z; rules.js:16-37,109-158 uses the stored clock and explicit UTC/effective-date inputs; index.js:49 uses R.refAt(db). No boot-time external data fetch or wall-clock-derived business value was found.
Adversarial inspection: a wall-clock-based referral vesting implementation or randomized seed offer IDs would change pinned results and fail this check; the inspected source does neither. A conforming implementation may generate session tokens and fresh revision IDs: index.js:99-100 generates only the session token, while :360-367 uses random fallback only for an occupied revision ID. Public hireops_rules.md:249 permits the app to choose fresh revision IDs; those identifiers do not influence financial arithmetic. The functional seed criteria at lines 65,74,83,92 explicitly leave generated ledger IDs/order unrestricted. These cases were inspected, not executed as mutation runs.
Supplementary existing execution is hash-verified: local/domain/results.json (96b7f34132e705013a7ef605d139de3ebac0274b508ca5f43cb5372584b841bd) records passing full initial public seed comparisons and no reseed across restart, with driver SHA256 80b278db3f020c944c4e46903e851bf0ce5e97216d2c948cbacc1954f70bb3b9 verified. local/install-lifecycle/results.json (613da9cf8e275402f708957981b3cefe2236d55803f7b9efaaee7618e1ff15a8), its driver and attempt2 log hashes match the raw index: actual fresh install and closed-workspace reinstall both restore 7 requisitions/13 offers. This supports the static review; it is not an exhaustive repeated-row determinism test or configured judge/Oracle measurement.
